answer.reason: The verses tell Joab's deeds at length, and four of them are major events: three killings and his own death.

clauses.english: killed Abner to avenge his brother Asahel
clauses.quote: smote him there under the fifth rib, that he died

clauses.english: killed Absalom as he hung in an oak
clauses.quote: thrust them through the heart of Absalom

clauses.english: killed Amasa with his sword while greeting him
clauses.quote: he smote him therewith in the fifth rib

clauses.english: was slain at the altar by Benaiah on Solomon's order
clauses.quote: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up, and fell upon him, and slew him

doubts: 2SA 11:16-17 (Uriah placed where he would die) and 2SA 12:26 (the capture of Rabbah) were left out to keep the line short.
1SA 26:6 and similar verses name Joab only as Abishai's brother; the same goes for the verses on Asahel.
1KI 11:15-16 says Joab smote every male in Edom, but I judged it a lesser event.
